label: Oldest allowance figure
means: Days since the oldest allowance figure on this tab or in its catalog was read on its provider's own page.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: free tiers change often, so a figure is re-read on its provider's page within a week; near: a month
source: read dates on the limits in params.systems_file and params.allowances, the registry rows' checked field, and each row's checked field in params.catalog_file, a committed file CI reads

params.comment: This repo's public page reads the plan catalog the repo publishes. The pack's other Credits metrics need local files, so they stay off this page (quality/config.json).
